data.one_liner: Store and query Cloud Firestore documents based on geographic locations.
data.what_it_does: geoflutterfire_plus allows Flutter apps to query geographic data saved in Cloud Firestore by using Geohashes. It provides tools to save geographic points, fetch locations within a radius, and subscribe to real-time location query streams.
use_when: You need to query Cloud Firestore documents within a specific geographic radius in real-time
You want to store location points along with their geohash strings in Firestore
avoid_when: You require built-in limit or orderBy queries directly on the geo query (limit and orderBy are currently not supported due to geohash algorithm and Firestore limitations)
You are not using Cloud Firestore as your backend
strengths: Enables radius-based location queries on Cloud Firestore
Supports real-time streams of location query results via rxdart
Works well with typed data using withConverter
weaknesses: Does not support limit and orderBy queries out of the box
Requires proper Firestore composite indexes for custom query conditions
data.setup_notes: Requires cloud_firestore configured in your Flutter project.
